Written by hand from a pitch grid, then checked against OMR (which agreed on pitches but missed the tremolo strokes, read the half-bar tremolo as a plain half chord, put 2 instead of 3 staves in one group and gave the key as B♭ major). Two-note tremolo <G3 B♭3>/D4 written as \repeat tremolo 8 { <g, bf>32 d' }: lilylet draws each tremolo note at half the total (quarter), as in modern LilyPond; Schubert's print shows half notes. lilylet bug: an accidental is redrawn on every repeated note in the bar (all four F♯ chords in bars 2-3 show a sharp; the original shows it once). Verovio hides the voice staff (rests only) on the 2nd system.
